notes: ACCESS: plain direct HTTPS fetch, HTTP 200, no WAF, no Rule 2 route needed. milton.in redirects to https://www.milton.in/. Platform is Shopify. robots.txt carries NO Claude-specific disallow (only 'User-agent: *' with Allow: / plus an 'adsbot-google' block and a Shopify agentic-commerce preamble), so the Amazon/Home24 opt-out precedent does not apply. LANGUAGE: html lang="en"; the whole storefront including every category name renders natively in English, no Hindi or regional-language category labels were encountered, so no translation was needed. RULE 3 IDENTITY CHECK PASSED - genuine corporate storefront, not a reseller: footer reads 'Copyright @ 2026 Hamilton Housewares Pvt. Ltd. All Right Reserved', Hamilton Housewares being the owner of the Milton brand. SIBLING-BRAND DETERMINATION: this is a single Hamilton Housewares storefront carrying the house brands together, not a set of separate brand hubs. Full /products.json enumeration returns 1146 products with vendors Milton (880), Treo (119), ProCook (83), Spotzero (41) and Milton Appliances (23); Treo items carry titles literally suffixed '(Treo by Milton)' and are merchandised inside Milton's own category collections - all of the glassware, opalware, ceramic mugs and the diya extracted here are Treo-vendor products sitting in Milton's Tableware tree. Treo and Spotzero are therefore counted as part of this company's catalogue. The site's own /collections/vendors brand-listing page was NOT extracted (brand listing pages are never extracted). Spotzero (cleaning) and ProCook (cookware) are wholly out of scope on product type anyway. COUNT METHOD (Rule 1): every qty comes from the rendered collection-page '<N> products' ProductCount element, and each was independently exhaustion-checked against full /collections/<handle>/products.json pagination (limit=250, all pages) counting DISTINCT handles. All 16 leaves matched exactly on both sources, so no Shopify products_count value was used anywhere and no inflated or variant-level count entered the data. Variant trap checked: Milton renders each opalware colourway as its own product handle (aurelia-collection-dinner-set-arashi/-selene/-lunis and so on) and the site counts them the same way - the 18 tiles on Opalware Dinner Set resolve to 18 distinct handles, so tiles, ProductCount and distinct product IDs all agree. SITEMAP vs LIVE NAV: sitemap_collections_1.xml lists 288 collections against 82 in the live header nav. The 204 extras were cross-checked and are price bands (under-999, under-1999-wedding), colour facets (blue-water-bottle), festival and gift campaigns (diwali-gifts, raksha-bandhan-rakhi-gifts), brand/bestseller/new-arrival roll-ups (treo-bestsellers, milton-new-arrivals) and unlinked SEO duplicates - all NEVER-EXTRACT classes. Two unlinked sitemap-only collections were checked directly and rejected: 'dining-serving' (114 products) is a mixed roll-up spanning casseroles, opalware, mugs and ProCook cookware and is not reachable from the live nav; 'opalware-plate-set' (4 Terrana plate sets) is an SEO collection absent from both the header menu and the on-page category rail of /collections/opalware, and its products already sit inside the extracted opalware leaves. The on-page category rail rendered on /collections/opalware reproduces the header tree exactly, confirming the header nav is the live tree. SCOPE - the great majority of Milton's catalogue is out of scope and was excluded: Bottles & Flasks (all 14 children - thermosteel/steel/copper/glass/PET bottles, carafes, kids bottles, baby products, ice packs, spares), Lunchboxes (all 8 children), Cookware (kadhai, tawa, pots, pressure cookers, appam pans, sandwich griller), Storage (jars, storage containers, fridge glass containers), Electric Appliances (all 7), Cleaning Products (all 7, Spotzero), Buckets & Dustbins, the Home Essentials leaf (medical box, first-aid box, bath mat), Gifting (occasion roll-ups) and all Spare Parts nodes. Within Tableware these leaves were additionally excluded on product type: Tumblers (11 - all Malmo/Maven thermosteel insulated travel tumblers, i.e. vacuum ware), Insulated Jugs (5 - Kool Rover/Seal/Musafir cooler jugs), Thermosteel Water Jugs (2 - vacuum insulated), Spares for Jugs & Tumblers, Oil Dispenser (1 - kitchen tool) and Glass Bakeware & Casseroles (1 - Ovensafe Deep Round Casserole, oven bakeware). CASSEROLES CALL (documented as instructed): Milton's casserole tree - 25 products = 15 insulated + 10 insulated steel + 1 microwavable, with Oyster Casserole shared between the first two so the union reconciles exactly to the parent's 25 - is INCLUDED as serveware rather than food storage. The determination came from Milton's own product copy, not the category name: the Oyster Casserole page reads 'The perfect serving casserole for any special occasions', 'adds a hint of royalty to your dining and enhances your dining decorum' and 'Enhance the look of your dining table with its premium shape and design'. These are Indian dining-table hot-pot serving pieces brought to the table with roti and curry. LIGHTING / MIRRORS ABSENCE CONFIRMED EMPIRICALLY, not assumed: the site's own /search endpoint is useless for this because it fuzzy-matches and returns a flat '1000 results' for every term including 'chandelier' and 'showpiece', so instead the entire 1146-product catalogue was enumerated via /products.json and title-scanned. Zero hits for lamp, mirror, vase, clock, planter, showpiece, decor, photo frame, tealight and wall art. The only 'candle' hits are 5 water-filter replacement candles (filtration cartridges) and the only 'tray' hits are two Treo tumbler/bowl sets already counted inside Glass Tumblers and Bowls Cups & Saucers. Milton therefore carries no lighting and no mirrors, and its sole decorative-accessory item is the single Arpan Diya. Rule 0.6: the site exposes only a product-type tree and no room tree, so there is no dual-tree overlap to reconcile. No parent qty was recorded; note that the Tableware parent collection itself reports 78 products, a curated subset rather than the union of its children (62 Opalware + 49 Jugs & Tumblers + 29 Bakeware & Serveware + 1 Oil Dispenser), another reason parents carry null here.
